It is early May, and the weather couldn't have been any more perfect. It's sunny, with occasional clouds providing a very needed cover from any excess heat.  But, you haven't taken a day off from work just to admire the season, you've done it for a certain someone. 
Just as you were about to look at your phone for time, it rang with a message notification.

*Done with the club for today. Are you gonna pick me up or make a lady walk all alone to our special place?*, it reads on the screen.

She knows you too well, because instead of going straight to your favorite bench in the park you, like always, wait for her at the school gates. High school gates, to be exact. Your special friend has been a high schooler since the new year began a month ago, and you've been using this as an excuse to feel better about dating a minor. At least she's not a middle schooler anymore, you think to yourself, perhaps a little too often.

Her face finds yours in no time. The same old sly vixen slant eyes and a smile that makes you wanna smack her, but in a good way, you suppose, since you've never actually done it, at least not yet. She almost frolics your way, before bumping into your big adult frame with her delicate, almost too thin to properly function body. 

"Did you miss me?" she asks, narrowing her eyes even further as she wraps her delicate hands around you. "Or am I just that good of an excuse not to show up at work today?"
